format: JSONL: one case per line; pass one file or a directory of *.jsonl files
scope: Grading only. Each case is an independent decision stage, not a grading pipeline.
templates: *.template.jsonl contain illustrative labels, not verified ground truth. Review/edit the cases, remove example=true, and save your dataset outside the template files before running.

case.id: Unique case ID across the dataset
case.task: One of the six tasks below
case.input: Context for the existing grading template; only this object is rendered
case.expected: All output labels for the task; never sent to the provider
case.example: Optional boolean; true prevents accidentally benchmarking template cases

selectedSense.definition: string; the GT-selected meaning, independent of stage 1

inventory: Include the complete neutral Sense inventory for stages selecting a Sense. IDs need not come from a database; expected labels must match the rendered sense_<id> keys.
benchmark_config: Copy root .env.example to root .env for provider key/URL/model. Edit benchmarks/config.json for per-model pricing and named benchmark profiles (mode/threshold/timeout). Select a profile with --benchmark grading_decision or --benchmark grading_llm. Pricing defaults to the selected env model's entry; a profile may reference another pricing entry explicitly with its pricing field. Null input/output rates mean unknown, not free.
structured_outputs: LLM_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS in root .env defaults to true; false prompts for JSON text and validates it locally without requiring provider JSON mode. An llm_only benchmark profile can override this with structured_outputs: false (or true); omitting it uses .env. Jev decision_only requests are unchanged.
temperature: LLM_TEMPERATURE in root .env is optional (blank omits the parameter). An llm_only profile can override with temperature: 0 (or another finite number from 0 to 2), or null to omit. Unsupported provider/model parameters remain provider errors; there is no automatic retry with changed settings. Temperature is saved in each run manifest.
pricing: Rates apply only to actual response model IDs listed in model_ids. Input is the total including cache read/write subsets. Null cache rates use the normal input rate; a different cache rate requires the corresponding reported token count. For request-priced providers, replace the token rates with per_request. Record as_of/source alongside the rates.
scoring: A case is correct only when all expected outputs match. Accuracy is the mean of per-task exact-match accuracies for the tasks present in the dataset. Errors count as incorrect.
